# gigahost_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone on the Gigahost account. Registered-domain settings are optional and only apply if configured; for an existing registered domain, import the zone before configuring DNSSEC or delegation. SLAVE zones can be created with the masters attribute.

## Example Usage

### DNS zone

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}
```

### Existing registered domain: nameservers and DNSSEC

Creating a DNS zone does **not** register a domain with Gigahost. Import
an existing registered domain to manage registry settings. Omitted optional
settings remain unmanaged.

```terraform
# Import an existing registered zone before managing registry settings.
resource "gigahost_dns_zone" "registered" {
  zone_name      = "example.no"
  nameservers    = ["ns1.gigahost.no", "ns2.gigahost.no", "ns3.gigahost.no"]
  dnssec_enabled = true
}

import {
  to = gigahost_dns_zone.registered
  id = "123"
}
```

For domains served by external nameservers, you can also configure
`external_ds_records` alongside `dnssec_enabled = true`. Nameservers are applied
before DNSSEC: changing nameservers of a `.no` domain disables DNSSEC and
removes existing DS records.

### Secondary (SLAVE) DNS zone

```terraform
# Secondary zones use the SLAVE zone type and specify their primary servers.
resource "gigahost_dns_zone" "secondary" {
  zone_name = "example.net"
  zone_type = "SLAVE"
  masters   = ["192.0.2.1", "192.0.2.2"]
}
```

SLAVE zones use the panel's undocumented `POST /dns/zones/secondary`
endpoint. Changing the master servers replaces the zone.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_name` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `dnssec_enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable DNSSEC for a registered domain; nameserver changes are applied first.
- `external_ds_records` (Attributes Set) Registry DS records for an externally hosted registered domain. Requires dnssec_enabled = true. Omit to leave unmanaged; disable DNSSEC to remove DS records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_ds_records))
- `masters` (Set of String) Primary DNS server IPs for a SLAVE zone. Changing the masters replaces the zone. This uses the secondary-zone creation API observed in the Gigahost panel (not publicly documented).
- `nameservers` (Set of String) Registry nameservers (at least 2) for an existing registered domain. Omitting leaves delegation unmanaged. Gigahost syncs apex NS records, but read-back can lag.
- `zone_type` (String) Zone type (NATIVE, MASTER, or SLAVE).

### Read-Only

- `dnssec_ds_records` (String) DS record text returned by Gigahost when DNSSEC is being managed.
- `domain_expiry_date` (String) Domain expiry date, if registered.
- `domain_status` (String) Domain registration status, if registered.
- `external_dns` (Boolean) Whether the zone is served by external nameservers.
- `registered` (Boolean) Whether the zone represents a registered domain.
- `zone_active` (Boolean) Whether the zone is active.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone id.
- `zone_protected` (Boolean) Whether the zone is protected against deletion.

<a id="nestedatt--external_ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_ds_records`

Required:

- `algorithm` (Number) DNSSEC signing algorithm.
- `digest` (String) Hexadecimal digest; Gigahost validates its length.
- `digest_type` (Number) Digest type: 1 (SHA-1), 2 (SHA-256) or 4 (SHA-384).
- `key_tag` (Number) DNSSEC key tag (0-65535).

Optional:

- `key_type` (Number) DNSKEY flags: 257 (KSK) or 256 (ZSK); used with public_key.
- `public_key` (String) Base64 DNSKEY public key; required for some TLDs (e.g. .be, .de, .eu, .nl).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# DNS zones can be imported by their zone id.
terraform import gigahost_dns_zone.example 123
```
